scope: All 100 test suites in the portable baseline; its other three entries are helper modules. Port-required and retired suites were not executed.

batches.selection: suite name at or after m
the 32 suites not passing before, rerun 2026-10-14 with the corrected runtime and root image

execution.path: inherited; compiler subprocesses routed through the VM root CLI

environmentRetries.reason: Sandbox denied local listener creation with Operation not permitted; rerun outside the sandbox with the same VM artifacts.

notes: Only the native TLS provider remains explicitly unresolved. Affected suites remain failures; no emission stubs were used.
The inventory combines disjoint suite selections from two batches using the same runtime, corpus image, and CLI image.
Every suite runs with incremental collector steps on allocation, the root oracle, and quarantine. This is not a full-collection-on-every-allocation run.

The runtime and child root CLI image are the final versions tested by root-cli-coverage.json. The corpus image predates the final conditional ownership activation fix; its dedicated fixture was subsequently validated on both interpreters, JIT, and compiled frames.
The 600-second limit applies to a whole suite. Timed-out suites retain any reported cases; the harness kills their subprocess group. A timeout is not evidence of a deadlock.

Failures include legacy bootstrap and bytecode assumptions, source-lowering gaps, provider and documentation dependencies, and compilation timeouts. Failure samples do not establish one cause for every failure.
A passing inventory or capability-report test does not establish support for an unavailable deployment target. Full CLI command coverage is recorded separately.

2026-10-14 rerun: safe navigation lowering, os.exit, debug.traceback, files.lines, runtime os/io lookups, @requires-dynamically image closure, byte-exact tostring and a stdlib fallback loader moved six suites to passing. Remaining failures are LuaJIT bytecode and bootstrap assumptions, C modules (ffi, lpeg, lunamark), unported native providers, stub catalogs, error positions, and GC-interleave timeouts.
